This one works well too — the row of all my labels sitting above the library let me pick "design" and it narrowed the same way, with the chosen label highlighted so I can see what I'm filtered to. And I can see the appeal: when I *don't* have a particular card in front of me and just want to browse "what have I been saving lately," seeing all my labels laid out to pick from is genuinely handy.

Honestly, unlike the earlier either/or choices, here I'd happily keep both. Tapping a label on a card is the natural move when something's already in front of me and I want more like it; the label row is the natural move when I'm starting fresh and want to browse my whole collection by topic. They serve two different moments and don't step on each other.

So my answer is: both, if you can. If you're forcing one for now, give me the label row above the library, since it works even when nothing's on screen yet — but the pills-on-cards being clickable is something I'd want back eventually. Either way, tapping a label to see everything under it is the behavior I want.
